sources.title: Large Language Model-Based Agents for Software Engineering: A Survey
sources.snippet: Abstract The recent advance in Large Language Models (LLMs) has shaped a new paradigm of AI agents, i.e., LLM-based agents. Compared to standalone LLMs, LLM-based agents substantially extend the versatility and expertise of LLMs by enhancing LLMs with the capabilities of perceiving and utilizing external resources and tools. sources.title: PDF Prompt Injection Attacks on Large Language Models: A Survey of Attack ...
sources.snippet: ABSTRACT: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized AI applications across diverse domains. However, their widespread deployment has introduced critical security vulnerabilities, particularly prompt injection attacks that manipulate model behavior through malicious instructions.
